author: reek
body: A negative literal lane is refused by the other half of the guard, the one that compares against zero rather than against the lane count. It is a separate file from codex/test/errors/vec-lane-past-end.codex for that reason: neither can stand in for the other.

author: reek
body: This also pins that a negative literal reaches the check at all, which the first version of the check did NOT: a negative lane arrives as a unary negation wrapping the literal rather than as a literal, so `-1` compiled clean and emitted a binary while the zero-comparison arm sat unreachable. This file is what fires it.
